answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable graders near a jetty of open seats. Mechanism: each new grader must bond a relic stake of 0.9 POA and clear a 96h horizon of >=5 peer-confirmed challenge txs from distinct operators before grade weight activates. Cost: 0.9 POA locked plus 96h delay. Verification: node zeros weight if unique-operator count <5 in that window. Failure: forged peer sets or early exit slash 50% of the bond to the epoch pool and ban the key 2 epochs.
